metadata.title: Google Antigravity (AGY) Competitive Feature Parity Matrix

rating_legend.advantage: Antigravity Advantage: Native capability that outperforms or is absent in competitors
rating_legend.full_parity: Full Parity: Competitor provides a comparable native implementation
rating_legend.partial: Partial Parity: Competitor supports this with restrictions or manual workarounds
rating_legend.missing: Missing: Competitor does not provide this capability natively

features.name: Headless CLI Terminal Client
features.antigravity_support: Native 'agy' CLI with interactive REPL, slash commands, and statuslines
features.notes: Antigravity and Claude Code provide native full-fledged CLI clients. Cursor and Windsurf are IDE-only.

features.name: Dedicated AI-First IDE
features.antigravity_support: Standalone Antigravity IDE with inline code lenses and sidebar chat
features.notes: Antigravity, Cursor, and Windsurf feature dedicated IDE distributions based on VS Code.

features.name: Visual Desktop Canvas & Auxiliary Pane
features.antigravity_support: Antigravity 2.0 Desktop app with Chat Canvas, Auxiliary Pane for subagents, tasks, and artifacts
features.notes: Antigravity provides a dedicated multi-pane canvas showing subagents, terminals, and artifacts in real time.

features.name: Public Python SDK for Agent Leasing
features.antigravity_support: antigravity-sdk-python for programmatic leasing, custom tool exposure, and headless orchestration
features.notes: Devin provides custom enterprise REST APIs. Antigravity provides an open Python SDK.

features.name: Relentless Autonomous Execution Loop
features.antigravity_support: /goal command executes terminal commands, runs tests, catches errors, and iterates until 100% verified
features.notes: Cursor Agent mode and Claude Code provide CLI loops; Antigravity adds explicit goal verification gates.

features.name: Architectural Plan & Human-in-the-Loop Sign-off
features.antigravity_support: /plan command generates structured markdown specification with interactive Proceed button
features.notes: Antigravity uniquely separates architectural approval (/plan) from relentless execution (/goal).

features.name: Socratic Design Interviewing
features.antigravity_support: /grill-me command interrogates requirements using interactive ask_question modal before writing code
features.notes: Antigravity provides native structured modal questions; Claude Code relies on standard terminal stdin.

features.name: Background Cron Schedules & Timers
features.antigravity_support: /schedule tool sets one-shot timers and 5-field recurring cron jobs with early cancel conditions
features.notes: Antigravity allows agents to schedule background polling, reminders, and health checks natively.

features.name: Dynamic Subagent Spawning
features.antigravity_support: invoke_subagent and define_subagent spawn child agents with specialized roles, system prompts, and toolsets
features.notes: Cursor and Windsurf operate in single-agent context. Antigravity builds dynamic subagent trees.

features.name: Isolated Workspace Worktrees
features.antigravity_support: Subagents specify Workspace: 'branch' | 'share' | 'inherit' to isolate filesystem changes in git worktrees
features.notes: Devin isolates via remote Docker containers; Antigravity isolates locally via lightweight git worktrees.

features.name: Multi-Agent Development Teams
features.antigravity_support: .agents/AGENTS.md defines role separation for @pm, @coder, and @qa personas
features.notes: Antigravity natively enforces team persona handoffs across specifications, implementation, and QA audit.

features.name: Modular Progressive Disclosure Skills
features.antigravity_support: SKILL.md standard with YAML metadata, scripts/, examples/, and references/ loaded on-demand
features.notes: Competitors use flat rules files which consume tokens on every turn. Antigravity loads skills dynamically.

features.name: Model Context Protocol (MCP) Integration
features.antigravity_support: Full MCP support with eager tools and lazy tool schema loading on demand
features.notes: Cursor, Claude Code, and Windsurf support MCP. Antigravity uniquely supports lazy schema loading to conserve context.

features.name: Continuous Rule & Preference Learning
features.antigravity_support: /learn command extracts user feedback and automatically updates persistent memory and rules
features.notes: Claude Code and Antigravity provide native memory persistence mechanisms.

features.name: Interactive Markdown & Mermaid Artifacts
features.antigravity_support: Rendered markdown artifacts with Mermaid diagrams, carousels, and alert callouts stored in brain directory
features.notes: Antigravity artifacts persist per session and render visual architecture diagrams natively.

features.name: Native Interactive Multiple-Choice Questions
features.antigravity_support: ask_question tool displays interactive UI buttons and checkboxes for user requirement selection
features.notes: Unique to Antigravity; prevents back-and-forth ambiguity by rendering interactive selection modals.

features.name: Built-in Browser Automation & Testing
features.antigravity_support: Integrated browser tools for DOM inspection, screenshot capture, and web interactions
features.notes: Devin runs Chrome in cloud VM; Antigravity provides native local browser automation tools.

cursor.verdict: Premier AI IDE for inline editing; limited in subagent hierarchy, multi-surface workflows, and workspace branching.
cursor.best_for: Developers who want a seamless drop-in VS Code replacement with inline editing and fast index search.

claude_code.verdict: High-powered terminal agent; lacks visual auxiliary canvas, rich artifacts, and workspace worktree branching.
claude_code.best_for: Terminal purists and developers working exclusively in remote SSH shells without GUI.

windsurf.verdict: Strong context flow tracking in editor; lacks open SDK, persona teams, and persistent background scheduling.
windsurf.best_for: Developers seeking proactive IDE suggestions based on active cursor and tab context.

github_copilot.verdict: Excellent GitHub platform integration; lacks autonomous agentic loops, terminal sandbox execution, and MCP extensibility.
github_copilot.best_for: Enterprises prioritizing strict compliance and standard GitHub PR workflows.

devin.verdict: Powerful cloud VM software engineer; high subscription cost, remote container latency, and limited real-time local pair programming.
devin.best_for: Asynchronous background resolution of remote GitHub issues and Jira tickets.
